title: default option selected when possible
name: Default option selected when possible — Polaris
rule: Default option selected whenever possible; “Select” placeholder only if no logical default. Dual-cite with GOV.UK settings vs questions — not a winner.
pass_when: Settings / when a logical current-or-safe default exists, it is selected. If no logical default, a “Select” placeholder is allowed in addition to a visible label (placeholder is extra, never only label). Questions: do not use this row to force a guessed answer; use explicit None when none is valid.
fail_when: Logical default exists on settings and is unused; or “Select” placeholder is the only label; or a guessed question answer is forced.
overview: Select a logical default when possible; Select placeholder only if none exists.
apply_when: Settings or selects where a current or safe default can be chosen.
not_when: Unused logical defaults, Select as only label, or guessed forced answers.
agent_hint: Preselect logical defaults on settings; allow Select placeholder only when none exists.
